_comment: Per-region colour palette guidance for the sprite artist (human or AI). Every sprite in a region should read coherently against these colours. Palettes are suggestive, not prescriptive — breakpoints and boss fights can stray, but ambient tiles and common NPCs should sit inside the region's bands. Low-res pixel art, 16-24 colours per region, readable at 32px.

heartlands.mood: warm neutrals, sunlit afternoons, hay and honey, gentle wind
heartlands.reference: English midlands in late summer — hedges, thatched roofs, cobble paths

moryskah.mood: damp, mossed stone, fog at knee height, candlelight through shutters, the feeling that dusk came early
moryskah.avoid: bright yellow grass, saturated skies, cheerful reds
moryskah.reference: eastern european folk horror — graveyards with herb gardens, bog witch huts, patched-roof inns

sootworks.mood: ember-lit industrial — coal dust, iron filings, the constant glow of molten bars and forge chimneys against a starless sky
sootworks.avoid: green grass, pastoral blues, natural daylight
sootworks.reference: Sheffield steelworks at 1am, OSRS Keldagrim filtered through Dwarf Fortress

saltbrine.mood: wind-flattened, salt-bleached, tar-smelling — piers, pulled-up boats, gulls, the light that only exists at coasts
saltbrine.avoid: forest greens, deep desert oranges, anything that reads inland
saltbrine.reference: Cornish fishing village meets OSRS Port Phasmatys — pirates welcome, dockmasters tired

veilwood.mood: broadleaf forest pierced by shafts of afternoon sun — mossy roots, elven banners, the feeling a stag is about to step into the clearing
veilwood.avoid: geometric urban shapes, industrial greys, water that looks like a puddle
veilwood.reference: OSRS Tirannwn + Princess Mononoke's deep-forest palette — living wood, not set-dressed wood

boneyard.mood: sun-bleached desert — bones whitened by heat, sandstone warm to touch, nomad tents, oasis water the colour of a promise
boneyard.avoid: cold blues, dense forest greens, any slate grey
boneyard.reference: OSRS Kharidian Desert + western-movie horizons — heat shimmer, scorpions in shadows, pyramids on horizons

inkweald.mood: violet dream-grass under a pale moon — brass instruments catch starlight wrong, ponds reflect the wrong sky, thoughts bloom into flowers
inkweald.avoid: earthy browns, pragmatic industrial colours, warm sunlight
inkweald.reference: Alan Wake surrealism + Studio Ghibli dream sequences — everything looks like it was remembered rather than seen

glass_desert.mood: heat-fused silica plains — crystal spires catch sun, glass underfoot crunches, the air wobbles at noon, mirages suggest water that isn't there
glass_desert.avoid: wet-looking surfaces, forest darkness, anything matte
glass_desert.reference: OSRS Desert Treasure 2 crystal caverns + Dune Part 2 sand palette with glass refraction

wilds.mood: dead-grass wasteland, burned bridges, places where old gods used to stand and nothing now grows, player-skull on the horizon
wilds.avoid: cheerful accents, clean architecture, green anything
wilds.reference: OSRS wilderness — low-budget hell, ruins rather than gothic, lava pits rather than volcanoes

drifting_market.mood: impossible bazaar that appears in different regions on different days — tents stitched from several climates' fabrics, lanterns burning oils no one sells, the merchant queen's palette
drifting_market.avoid: geographically coherent palettes — the point is that it doesn't belong
drifting_market.reference: Moving Market from Howl's Moving Castle + Spirited Away bathhouse colour riots

universal.mood: anything that must work in any region — coins, tools, generic food — a warm neutral default that reads everywhere
universal.avoid: palette choices that cue a specific region
universal.reference: OSRS inventory iconography — warm, tactile, readable at 32px
